numberPattern.title: Order number form
numberPattern.description: {prefix}{number}: one running number (SH-001043). {prefix}{year}-{number}: the number starts again each year, by your business time zone's year (SH-2026-0043).

numberPrefix.title: Order number prefix
numberPrefix.description: Put before every order number (for example SH-): letters, digits, - and _ (other characters are left out, as order numbers go in addresses).

messageChannels.title: Order messages by
messageChannels.description: How shoppers get order messages, through Notifications.

policyFormat.title: Policy format
policyFormat.description: Plain text, or HTML (paragraphs, lists, headings, bold, italic, underline, quotes, and links to https addresses, your own pages, mailto: and tel:).

returnsAccepted.title: Returns without the Returns feature
returnsAccepted.description: What search engines are told about returns while the Returns feature is off: nothing, or that you take no returns. With Returns on, its return window says it.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods offered
paymentMethods.description: Online payment and bank transfer go through Payments (paste its token in Connections); pay at pickup needs a pickup location. Cash on delivery is its own feature.

paymentWindowMinutes.title: Time to pay (minutes)
paymentWindowMinutes.description: An order paid online or by bank transfer (or a cash-on-delivery advance) that is not paid within this time is canceled and its stock given back. 0 = never canceled.

confirmationHours.title: Time to confirm (hours)
confirmationHours.description: A cash-on-delivery or pay-at-pickup order your staff do not confirm within this time is canceled and its stock given back. 0 = never canceled.

openOrderCap.title: Waiting orders per customer
openOrderCap.description: A customer may have at most this many orders waiting for payment or confirmation (0 = no limit).

addressRequired.title: Required address fields
addressRequired.description: Besides the name and phone. Leave out the city for one free-text address.

guests.title: Guest checkout
guests.description: Off: shoppers sign in to order. On: anyone orders with a name and phone. Unless password: a phone that belongs to a member with a password must sign in (checked with Accounts).

defaultCallingCode.title: Default calling code
defaultCallingCode.description: For phones typed without a country code (guests, alerts, delivery addresses), for example +44 or +1. Empty: the calling code of the country in business.json; without one, numbers must start with + or 00.

trunkPrefix.title: National trunk prefix
trunkPrefix.description: Dropped from national numbers before the calling code is added, for example 0. Empty: the country's usual prefix (0; 8 for +7; none where national numbers keep their 0, as in Italy).

countries.title: Countries of guest and alert phones
countries.description: Only phones with these countries' calling codes may be used to order as a guest or to get alerts; alerts never go to a member's phone of another country. Empty: any country.

customerRecords.title: Customers appear
customerRecords.description: First order: a customer record is made with their first order (or when staff open an Accounts user). Sign in: also as soon as a signed-in shopper uses the shop, before any order.

paymentOrder.title: Payment methods order
paymentOrder.description: The order the cart lists them; the first available is preselected.

successUrl.title: Success page
successUrl.description: Where shoppers return after placing or paying, with {number} and {id}. Empty = the page they ordered from with ss_order.

cancelUrl.title: Payment canceled page
cancelUrl.description: Where shoppers return when they leave a payment, with {number} and {id}. Empty = as the success page.

bankTransferVia.title: Bank transfers
bankTransferVia.description: Payments: through Payments' bank page. Manual: the order waits for the shopper's proof and staff record the payment. Either way, while Payments is connected, bank transfer is offered only once its bank details are saved there (or its Require bank details is off).

editPricing.title: Staff edits of waiting orders
editPricing.description: Reprice: an edited order is priced again (its offers as placed, its delivery fee and cash handling fee worked out anew). Keep placed amounts: it keeps the offer discount, delivery fee and payment fee it was placed with (the discount at most what the items come to).

deleteGivesBack.title: Deleting an order gives back
deleteGivesBack.description: Held: what an order not delivered yet holds (stock, offer uses, redeemed points). All: also the items, offer uses and points of a delivered or closed order (its stock back, earned points taken back, redeemed points given back).

numberDigits.title: Order number digits
numberDigits.description: The fewest digits of the number part (zeros in front): SH-001043 has 6, SH-2026-0043 has 4.

statusTemplates.title: Status messages
statusTemplates.description: One: one template for every status. Per status: ecommerce.order_status.<status key> per status.

orderUrl.title: Order page address
orderUrl.description: For messages, with {number}, for example https://shop.com/orders/{number}.
